newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent makes new high on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent makes new high on short-covering.

text.p: IPE Brent pushed to new highs in early evening trade, propelled higher by a wave of short-covering, brokers said.
"There's no headlines out there. It's just a short-covering rally...the States is very strong," said one dealer.
April Brent touched a session high of $19.40 a barrel, before retreating to $19.28 at 1839 GMT, 36 cents up on the day.
Earlier, trade on NYMEX crude and products contracts appeared to be stifled by looming API data to be released after the close of business on Tuesday.
Some good buying came in late in the day, brokers said.
"People needed to cover positions so they had to come in anyway," said one.
